transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I came in because my mind just won't hold onto things anymore. I sit down to write a simple note for this youth maker program I help with... something I could do in my sleep before. But now, the numbers and words just sort of... scatter on me.
When did you first notice these problems with your memory? Have they been getting worse over time or did they come on suddenly?
About three weeks, I suppose. It... it wasn't really a gradual thing. It just started right after my older sister passed away.

Have you noticed any other changes in your thinking or memory besides the words and numbers scattering? Things like getting lost in familiar places, trouble following conversations, or not recognizing people you know?
No, nothing like that. I know where I am and... who people are. It's just the concentrating part.
Since your sister passed away, have you been feeling more down, hopeless, or overwhelmed by sadness?

I suppose so, yes. It's... well, most days I just wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. And... even when my wife is talking to me, trying to be kind about things, I just... I feel like I'm sitting at the bottom of a well. That's all.
Have you had any days recently where you felt little to no pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?

Yes... I suppose I have. I just... I haven't touched the wood pieces on my bench in a while. I skipped the choir planning meeting... and my chess games. Even fishing... it just sounds like more effort than it's worth right now. That's... not really like me.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or feeling restless and unable to sit still?

I suppose... yes. Everything just feels... slow. Getting out of my chair, or... even just trying to answer you right now. It's like... like my body and my tongue are trying to move through wet cement. Just... heavy.
Have you ever felt like you're seeing or hearing things that others don't, or had thoughts that you can't quite explain but feel very real to you?
No... no, I haven't. Nothing like that. I don't hear things or... see things. Just... what I already told you.
